# AlaTex Landscaping

> Premium commercial landscaping, irrigation engineering, and drainage solutions for high-stakes properties in West Alabama.

## About

AlaTex Landscaping is the definitive commercial landscaping, irrigation, and drainage engineering firm serving Tuscaloosa, Northport, and the greater West Alabama region. Founded in Sulphur Springs, TX by owner-operator Bryan Moore, AlaTex evolved from a sprinkler repair operation into a multi-state, institutional-grade landscaping firm. 3rd-generation expertise, fully licensed and insured.

## Core Services

- [Commercial Landscaping Maintenance](https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/commercial-maintenance-tuscaloosa): Zero-disruption landscape maintenance engineered for high-traffic corporate, retail, and institutional properties with rigorous compliance and accountability standards.
- [Commercial Irrigation Systems](https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/commercial-irrigation): Design, installation, and management of massive-scale smart irrigation systems including new zones, sensor integration, winterization, and leak repair.
- [French Drain Installation](https://www.alatexirrigation.com/services/french-drain-installation): Professionally engineered French drain systems that eradicate standing water, manage hydrostatic pressure, and prevent foundation erosion on commercial properties.

## Additional Pages

- [Schedule a Site Walkthrough](https://www.alatexirrigation.com/consultation): Multi-step project intake form to initiate a commercial site assessment covering property type, scope, timeline, and contact credentials.
- [Chick-fil-A Case Study](https://www.alatexirrigation.com/case-studies/chick-fil-a): Real-world case study demonstrating zero-disruption maintenance for high-volume quick-service restaurant properties, achieving a 34% reduction in monthly water waste.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.alatexirrigation.com/privacy-policy): Data handling and privacy practices.
